gd: Gd is a nerve agent easily absorbed into the body.
Gd can also mean a ductile silvery-white ductile ferromagnetic trivalent metallic element of the rare earth group.
Gd means the same as soman or gadolinium or atomic number 64.
gdansk: Gdansk is a port city of northern Poland near the mouth of the Vistula River on a gulf of the Baltic Sea.
Gdansk means the same as Danzig.
gdp: GDP is the measure of an economy adopted by the United States in 1991.
GDP means the same as gross domestic product.
